entries.head: touch up

senses.en: to fix or add a little makeup

example.en: I need two minutes to touch up before the meeting.
example.zh: 开会前给我两分钟补个妆。

entries.l1_note: “补妆”不是 fix the makeup；touch up 也用于修照片、修细节。

entries.head: wipe off

senses.en: to remove something by rubbing with a cloth

example.en: Wipe off that smudge under your eye before you go in.
example.zh: 进去之前把眼睛下面那块擦掉。

entries.l1_note: 擦掉用 wipe off，不是 wipe out（那是消灭、累垮）。

entries.head: wash off

senses.en: to remove something with water

example.en: This cleanser washes off easily with warm water.
example.zh: 这个洁面用温水一冲就掉。

entries.l1_note: wash off 是洗掉表面；wash up 是洗手或洗碗（美式）。

entries.head: blend in

senses.zh: 把眼影或修容边缘推开
senses.en: to make makeup edges smooth so they are not visible

example.en: Blend in the eyeshadow with a clean brush.
example.zh: 用干净刷子把眼影边缘晕开。

entries.l1_note: blend in 也指“融入人群”，语境决定。

entries.head: fill in

senses.en: to add color to the gaps in your eyebrows

example.en: Fill in the ends of your brows — they look uneven.
example.zh: 把眉毛尾部填一下，看着不对称。

entries.l1_note: 美式填表是 fill out；fill in 在这里是“填补空白”。

entries.head: rub in

senses.en: to rub a cream into your skin

example.en: Rub in the moisturizer while your face is still damp.
example.zh: 趁脸还湿的时候把面霜揉进去。

entries.l1_note: rub in 和 rub it in 还有一个习语义“反复揭人伤疤”，别误用。

entries.head: pat in

senses.en: to press a product into the skin gently with your fingers

example.en: Pat in the eye cream — don't drag the skin.
example.zh: 眼霜要轻拍进去，别拉扯皮肤。

entries.l1_note: 眼部护理动词是 pat，不是 rub（揉会拉扯）。

entries.head: work in

senses.zh: 用手法把产品揉进皮肤
senses.en: to massage a product into the skin

example.en: Work the serum in with small circles.
example.zh: 用打小圈的方式把精华揉进去。

entries.l1_note: work in 还有“挤时间安排”，看宾语。

entries.head: clean off

senses.en: to remove makeup completely

example.en: Clean off your makeup before bed — no exceptions.
example.zh: 睡前把妆卸干净，没有例外。

entries.l1_note: 卸妆不是 remove makeup 才自然；clean off 更口语。

entries.head: freshen up

senses.en: to wash and tidy yourself up a little

example.en: I'll freshen up and meet you downstairs in ten.
example.zh: 我补个妆，十分钟后楼下见。

entries.l1_note: freshen up 是整体整理，不只是补妆。

entries.head: even out

senses.en: to become more regular or smooth

example.en: The redness evened out after a week of using the cream.
example.zh: 用了一周那个霜，泛红均匀多了。

entries.l1_note: “变均匀”不是 become even（也有点怪）；even out 强调过程。

entries.head: plump up

senses.en: when skin looks fuller and healthier

example.en: This serum plumps up fine lines around the eyes.
example.zh: 这个精华能让眼周细纹饱满起来。

entries.l1_note: plump up 也指把枕头拍松，语境不同。

entries.head: puff up

senses.en: to become swollen

example.en: My eyes puffed up after I slept in my contacts.
example.zh: 我戴着隐形睡了一觉，眼睛肿了。

entries.l1_note: 肿是 puff up / swell up，不是 become big。

entries.head: swell up

senses.en: to become larger because of injury or allergy

example.en: My lip swelled up after the new lip balm.
example.zh: 用了新润唇膏，我嘴唇肿了。

entries.l1_note: swell up 比 puff up 程度重，常跟过敏、受伤。

entries.head: flare up

senses.en: when a skin condition suddenly gets worse

example.en: My eczema flares up every time the weather turns dry.
example.zh: 天一干我的湿疹就发作。

entries.l1_note: flare up 也用于冲突、火势，皮肤语境很常见。

entries.head: act up

senses.en: when part of your body starts behaving badly

example.en: My skin has been acting up since I changed cleansers.
example.zh: 换了洁面之后我的皮肤一直在闹。

entries.l1_note: act up 也指机器故障、小孩闹；主语是“出问题的东西”。

entries.head: come off

senses.en: when makeup rubs off or wears away

example.en: My foundation came off on the mask by noon.
example.zh: 中午粉底全蹭到口罩上了。

entries.l1_note: come off 也指“显得、成功”，看主语。
collocations: it came off on my shirt

entries.head: stay on

senses.en: when makeup stays in place for a long time

example.en: This lipstick stays on through lunch and coffee.
example.zh: 这支口红吃完午饭喝完咖啡还在。

entries.l1_note: “持妆”不是 keep makeup；stay on 是妆自己待住。

entries.head: build up

senses.en: to add makeup in thin layers to get more coverage

example.en: Build up the coverage slowly — one layer at a time.
example.zh: 遮瑕要慢慢叠，一层一层来。

entries.l1_note: build up 也指“积累、增强”，护肤语境是叠涂。

entries.head: layer on

senses.en: to apply products in layers

example.en: Don't layer on three serums at once — your skin will hate it.
example.zh: 别一次叠三种精华，皮肤受不了。

entries.l1_note: layer on 是主动涂很多层；build up 强调逐渐增强效果。

entries.head: go on

senses.en: how a product feels when you apply it

example.en: This foundation goes on smoothly and doesn't cake.
example.zh: 这个粉底上脸很顺，不卡粉。

entries.l1_note: go on 也指“继续、发生”，这里主语是产品。

entries.head: soak in

senses.en: when a product is absorbed by the skin

example.en: Give the serum a minute to soak in before the next step.
example.zh: 让精华吸收一分钟再做下一步。

entries.l1_note: 吸收是 soak in / sink in，不是 be absorbed（太书面）。

entries.head: dry out

senses.en: when skin loses moisture and becomes dry

example.en: My skin dries out every winter in the office AC.
example.zh: 每年冬天在办公室空调里我的皮肤都干。

entries.l1_note: dry out 是变干；dry off 是擦干水。

entries.head: break out

senses.en: to suddenly get spots on your skin

example.en: I break out every time I try a new foundation.
example.zh: 我每次换新粉底都会爆痘。

entries.l1_note: 爆痘是 break out；break out in 后面要跟疹子、汗这类具体东西。
collocations: break out after a new product

entries.head: smooth out

senses.en: to make a surface flat and even

example.en: Smooth out the base around your nose — it's patchy there.
example.zh: 把鼻子周围的底妆抹匀，那里斑驳了。

entries.l1_note: smooth out 也指解决问题、缓和关系。

entries.head: dab on

senses.en: to apply a small amount with light presses

example.en: Dab on a little concealer instead of rubbing it.
example.zh: 遮瑕点涂，别来回搓。

entries.l1_note: 点涂是小面积轻按，不是 smear（抹开）。

entries.head: slap on

senses.en: to put something on quickly and carelessly

example.en: I slapped on some sunscreen and ran for the bus.
example.zh: 我胡乱抹了点防晒就冲去赶公交。

entries.l1_note: slap on 带“随便一糊”的贬义或自嘲，别说别人 slap on。

entries.head: peel off

senses.en: to pull something off a surface, like a sheet mask

example.en: Peel off the mask after fifteen minutes and pat in the rest.
example.zh: 十五分钟后把面膜揭掉，剩下的轻拍吸收。

entries.l1_note: peel off 也指脱衣服、脱离车队，看宾语。

entries.head: hold up

senses.en: to stay in good condition over time

example.en: The mascara held up through a workout and a nap.
example.zh: 这支睫毛膏扛过了健身和午睡。

entries.l1_note: hold up 也指“耽搁、抢劫、站得住脚”，持妆是其中一义。

entries.head: melt off

senses.en: when makeup slides off because of heat or sweat

example.en: My foundation melted off on the subway platform.
example.zh: 在地铁站台上我的粉底全化了。

entries.l1_note: “脱妆”口语常说 melt off / come off，不说 the makeup is gone。
